prompts: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE new 16:9 landscape CT examination CG for Hoshimi Hospital, matching supplied reference ONLY in ART STYLE: polished Japanese visual-novel illustration, precise clean dark contours, expressive mature anime faces, structured glossy hair highlights, distinct layered cel shadows, rich clean colors, finely painted contemporary Japanese hospital interior. Reference depicts blood sampling: do NOT copy that procedure or equipment. CT scanner must be unmistakable: a SHORT wide circular white donut gantry, opening visible through to room on other side, thin motorized patient couch aligned precisely through center. NOT a long MRI tunnel. Patient is an adult woman around 30-40 in a modest pale blue hospital gown, chest and pelvis covered, white sheet over legs, anatomically coherent relaxed pose, no jewelry. When staff appears, adult female clinician in pure WHITE short-sleeve nurse uniform with white collar/cuffs and white nurse cap, neatly tied brown hair. Exactly two arms/hands per person, sensible perspective and apparatus continuity. Calm professional clinical atmosphere; clear subject at 800x450 popup. No exposed intimate anatomy, blood, needles, glamour posing or childish proportions. No readable text, captions, logos, watermark or game UI. Complete opaque background. Variant 1: pre-scan bedside positioning. Medium-wide oblique view from foot-left side of CT couch. Patient with shoulder-length dark brown hair lies at RIGHT, head comfortably centered in headrest near gantry opening, relaxed hands on covered torso, attentive expression toward nurse. Nurse stands at LEFT and gently smooths the sheet at patient's shoulder with one hand while other hand rests on couch edge, reassuring professional demeanor. Scanner is IDLE during positioning. Large short donut gantry behind patient's head at right, table projects toward bottom left, soft daylight and mint-accented white walls, crisp blue shadows, tidy equipment. Both faces and whole upper body visible, strong composition without clutter.
